title: fix(app-shell): the draft preview bar's count follows a runtime view-config Save or Publish (objectui#13139)
body:
Fixes #13139
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The draft preview bar's count now follows a runtime view-config Save or Publish without a reload.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` (the ADR-0034 runtime persistence seam) gains one private helper, `announceDraftLedgerWrite()`, which raises the assistant bus's `emitMetadataRefresh()` pulse. Each of the seam's four write functions calls it after its write resolves: `persistRuntimeMetadata` (a draft save), `createRuntimeMetadata` (a new draft), `discardRuntimeDraft` and `publishRuntimeMetadata`. A refused write throws before the call, so it raises nothing. The helper never throws: a listener that fails is logged with `console.warn` and cannot turn a write that landed into a reported failure (the same rule `invalidateViewCaches` keeps).

No export, prop, type member, schema key or locale key moves. `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` and `ObjectView.tsx` are not touched.

## Why the seam (mechanism, measured at `c209c93`)

1. **`usePendingDrafts` re-reads on the pulse, on mount, and on nothing else of its own.** Its effect subscribes to `subscribeMetadataRefresh`; `DraftPreviewBar` adds one more re-read on a pathname change. Confirmed.
2. **The runtime path raised no pulse.** The card names `saveRuntimeMetadataDraft`; no symbol of that name exists in the tree (`git grep` zero hits, with `persistRuntimeMetadata` as the hit control). The save is `persistRuntimeMetadata`, called by `ObjectView`'s `handleViewConfigSave` (the Edit view config panel's Save) and by `ReportView`'s save. The publish is `publishRuntimeMetadata`, called only by `RuntimeDraftBar`'s `handlePublish`, which is the panel's Publish. Enumerating the non-test callers of all four seam writers (`ObjectView`, `ObjectDataPage`, `ReportView`, `RuntimeDraftBar`) found no runtime draft write that bypasses the seam, so the seam is the one place every save and publish succeeds, and the pulse goes there rather than in four call sites.
3. **Is the pulse publish-only by design?** The two docblocks that describe it (`usePendingDrafts.ts`'s module doc, and the `emitMetadataRefresh` section of `assistantBus.ts`) name publish and install. Landed code already raises it on a draft STAGE: `AiChatPage` announces every tool result that stages a draft ("when a tool STAGES or PUBLISHES something, announce it on the bus so every pending-drafts surface ... converges immediately", objectui#5801 and objectui#12725), and its `discardDrafts` raises it too. So the pulse is already the "pending-drafts ledger changed" signal for a stage, and this change adds the runtime seam as one more raiser of it. The docblock wording is left as it is (see Acceptance notes).

The pulse also drops the `_drafts` reads already on the wire before the hooks re-read (`usePendingDrafts`'s module-level subscriber), so the count installed after a save is read after the save landed.

### What else the pulse does

Every mounted `MetadataProvider` refetches its loaded types in place and clears the adapter's cache on the pulse. That already happens on a Studio or chat publish and on every agent-staged draft. An open `ViewConfigPanel` keys its draft on the view id (`stableKey`), so a refetch does not reset the panel; the affected-set run below includes the panel's and `ObjectView`'s save suites, green.

## Bounded in-place widening: create and discard

`createRuntimeMetadata` and `discardRuntimeDraft` get the same call. All four conditions hold: the same defect (a stale pending count after a runtime draft write), the same one-line call, the same claimed file, the same test file and gate family. The seam's own doc already applies `invalidateViewCaches` to every write function for the same reason. Evidence: the second test below, red under the ablation.

## Tests

New: `packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.pendingDraftsPulse-13139.test.tsx`, rendering the real `DraftPreviewBar` on an object list route under `?preview=draft`, against a fake `_drafts` ledger that the fake metadata client writes. The bar's state is read from its controls (`draft-preview-changes` with its count, `draft-preview-publish`), not its copy, so the queued copy change (objectui#13140) does not move these pins.

- Save then Publish: the bar goes from no pending change, to `(1)` with Publish offered, to no pending change.
- Create then Discard: the same two moves.
- A refused save and a refused publish: no pulse, no new `_drafts` read, the bar keeps `(1)`; then a control publish that lands raises exactly one pulse and empties the bar.
- A pulse listener that throws: the save still resolves, and the failure is logged once.

All run at head `1a44cc8`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 126 test files that import the seam, `ObjectView`, `ObjectDataPage`, `ReportView`, `RuntimeDraftBar`, `ViewConfigPanel` or `ReportConfigPanel`, every `preview/` test, and the new file: `Test Files 126 passed (126)`, `Tests 1102 passed (1102)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`, `deleteView.homes.test.ts`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`, `view-filter-fold.ratchet.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/unit-registry-absence-collision.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 154 passed (154)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the new test is in the second program, counted with `--listFilesOnly`): exit 0.

### Ablation (one-off, not kept)

At `6490c3e` (the fix committed), `ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the helper's single `emitMetadataRefresh();` call with a no-op (anchor 1 to 0, blob `a25445d376c4` to `7b66504f08f3`) and ran the new file plus `runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts`: `Tests 4 failed | 31 passed (35)`, all four failures in the new file (the refused-write test fails on its control leg, as intended: its refused half is green on both trees). Restore proven by the tool: blob back to `a25445d376c4`, equal to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. With the fix: `Tests 35 passed (35)`.

## Local gates (head `1a44cc8`)

Exit 0, each: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (1 changeset declared for 1 released package), `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:metadata-write-doors`, `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`, `pnpm check:pre-install-import-graph`, `pnpm check:phantom-deps`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`. ESLint over the two changed source files: 0 errors (8 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all on lines this change does not touch).

NOT MEASURED locally: `pnpm check:eager-closure`, reason: it reads `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, which needs a console build this run did not make (the script exits 2, "broken gauge"). The new import edge is between two modules already in `@object-ui/app-shell`. CI's run is the reading. Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `usePendingDrafts.ts` and `assistantBus.ts` still describe the pulse as raised by publish and install paths, while the chat's staging path and now the runtime seam also raise it on a draft write. Not edited here: both files are outside this card's surface. Carrier: none.
- Read-only inference, not measured in a browser: the list tab bar's rename, pin, set-default and delete go through the adapter's `updateView` / `deleteView`, not this seam, and raise no pulse. `updateView` writes a draft only when one is already pending, so it should not move the count; `deleteView` removing a draft-only view could. Carrier: none.
- Not touched, by the claim: `preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx`'s copy (objectui#13140, queued), `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` (objectui#13125), the record dialog host in `ObjectView.tsx` (objectui#13130).
